name: Data Classification & Validation
description: Classifies and validates data handled by agents using standardized data classification codes (DC codes). Maps declared data types to regulatory requirements, enabling automatic overlay activation and ensuring appropriate controls are applied based on data sensitivity.
threat_addressed: Incorrect or missing data classification causes the wrong regulatory overlays to activate (or none at all), resulting in under-protection of sensitive data and false compliance posture.
enforcement_mechanism: All data sources classified per the framework taxonomy (16 types). Runtime validation using pattern detection (regex, Luhn, co-occurrence) compares observed data patterns against declared classifications. Discrepancy alerts triggered on mismatch.

security_outcome.pass: All data sources tagged. No unclassified sources in agent ecosystem. Runtime validation active for pattern-detectable data types. No unresolved classification discrepancy alerts.
security_outcome.fail: Data handling declared but classification validation failed or undeclared sensitive data detected.

display_detail: Validates data classification declarations and ensures appropriate controls are activated for declared data sensitivity.
remediation_hint_template: Data classification incomplete. Declare all data types your agent handles in my_agent_handles in ancilis.yaml.
